read.cue: a teammate is already locked onto the doorstep man, so the open threat is the weak-side point with a clear shooting lane

interaction.prompt: The puck's in your corner. Read who your teammates already have, then drag YOURSELF (the defence) to the open threat.

feedback.right: Yes. Your teammate already has the doorstep man, so charging the net just double-covers him and leaves the point wide open for a clean shot. Take the open player — the weak-side point.
feedback.wrong: Your instinct screams 'net-front,' but a teammate is already there. Doubling up leaves the point man alone with a clear lane. Cover the OPEN threat, not the one that's handled.

tip: Don't double-cover. Check who your teammates already have, then take the open player.
why: Good defenders read the whole picture. Crashing the net your partner already owns leaves a different shooter free — coverage is about taking the UNcovered threat, not the scariest-looking one.
